summary: Anfield Energy filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release providing an operational update on the renewal and reactivation of its radioactive materials license for the Shootaring Canyon Uranium Mill. The company completed drilling 8 additional monitoring wells, began removal of existing leach tanks for refurbishment, and continues detailed engineering with PSE Engineering. License renewal is expected by end of 2026, with production targeted for 2027. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine operational update.
